YNot1989 wrote:
Post. The point of the Hakari-Hakari is to illustrate just how exceedingly rare it is for a civilization to survive long enough to develop faster than lite travel, and to postulate the worst case scenario where the species that achieves FTL outside of humanity is a bunch of tough as nails warlike megalomaniacs.

Humanity's greatest challenge yet. oohh I can't wait!
